name: stratospher
cooked: of the 587 peers I checked (not exhaustive, there may be more), there were only 54 distinct getaddr responses. peers in the same group return the same ~1000 addresses with the same timestamps, differing by only 1–2 entries, while different groups share almost nothing. So the 587 IPs are most likely just 54 nodes reachable through roughly 4–25 IPs.
